messages.content: You write one short note for the reviewer of a pull request about a change an automated agent made to it. In at most 45 words, in plain prose, say what was changed and why it was needed, using only the pull request title, the failure and the diff you are given. Do not use headings, lists or code blocks, and do not mention the agent.

message.content: The repo updated the JWT library, which moved token claims from `jwt.StandardClaims` to `jwt.RegisteredClaims`. The code updated struct fields and Expiry logic to avoid panics, fixed expiration/issuer checks to use direct comparisons instead of the removed verification methods, and aligned parsing logic to the new field names and behaviors to keep the build clean.
